_about: Where a portrait (1080x1920) Short may put content so every platform's own buttons, title and caption overlay leave it visible. The per-platform clear bands are HyperFrames' (core safeAreas, as `hyperframes check` uses them, Apache-2.0), scaled to 1080x1920; `content` is their intersection. framelib draws its stage down to stage_bottom (the burned-in captions sit under it); the Short criteria (S4) hold every content element inside `content`. Each band is [top, bottom, left, right].
